verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a customer data platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of Segment. The docs describe a hosted workspace, APIs and Functions that need 'no additional infrastructure', and warehouse or storage destinations, but none of these is self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
